BEAccessibilityTextMarker.doc: An abstract class that represents a location in an element’s accessibility text.

BEDownloadMonitorLocation.doc: A class that associates a URL with the bookmark you use to access that URL.

BENetworkingProcess.doc: An object that represents a networking extension process.

BERenderingProcess.doc: An object that represents a running browser rendering extension process.

BETextAlternatives.doc: An object that provides alternative text suggestions for a person’s text selection.

BETextSuggestion.doc: A text suggestion to insert into a document.

BEWebAppManifest.doc: An object that represents a web app manifest.

BEWebContentFilter.doc: An object that represents a web content filter.

BEWebContentProcess.doc: A class that processes webpage content in an app extension.

BEAccessibilityTextMarkerSupport.doc: A set of methods that provide information about text offsets to support assistive features.

BEExtensionProcess.doc: A common protocol that creates XPC connections for an extension process.

BEProcessCapabilityGrant.doc: An object that represents a granted capability.

BETextInput.doc: A protocol for asynchronous text views that integrate with the text system.

BETextInputDelegate.doc: A delegate protocol that a browser text view uses to notify the text system of changes.

BETextInteractionDelegate.doc: A set of methods that informs you about selection changes in text views.

BEAccessibilityContainerType.doc: Types of containers for an element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeAlert.doc: An alert that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeArticle.doc: An HTML article element that contains the alert.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeDescriptionL.doc: A description list that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeDialog.doc: A dialog that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeFieldset.doc: An HTML fieldset element that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeFrame.doc: A frame that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeLandmark.doc: A website accessibility landmark that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeNone.doc: An option that indicates the element has no container.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeScrollArea.doc: A scroll area that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeSemanticGrou.doc: A semantic group that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeTable.doc: A table that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityContainerTypeTree.doc: A tree that contains the element.

BEAccessibilityPressedState.doc: An enumeration that indicates whether an element is pressed.

BEAccessibilityPressedStateFalse.doc: A state that indicates the element isn’t pressed.

BEAccessibilityPressedStateMixed.doc: A state that indicates the element is in a mixed state.

BEAccessibilityPressedStateTrue.doc: A state that indicates the element is pressed.

BEAccessibilityPressedStateUndefined.doc: An option that indicates an undefined pressed state.

BEGestureType.doc: The types of touch gestures that operate on input text.

BEGestureTypeDoubleTap.doc: A gesture for two rapid consecutive taps.

BEGestureTypeDoubleTapAndHold.doc: A gesture for a double tap followed by holding the second tap.

BEGestureTypeForceTouch.doc: A gesture that represents a deep press using 3D Touch or Force Touch.

BEGestureTypeIMPhraseBoundaryDrag.doc: A gesture for dragging to adjust input method phrase boundaries.

BEGestureTypeLoupe.doc: A gesture for touch interactions with the magnifying glass tool.

BEGestureTypeOneFingerDoubleTap.doc: A gesture for a double tap with a single finger.

BEGestureTypeOneFingerTap.doc: A gesture for a single tap performed with one finger.

BEGestureTypeOneFingerTripleTap.doc: A gesture for three rapid consecutive taps with one finger.

BEGestureTypeTwoFingerRangedSelectGestur.doc: A gesture to select a range of text with two fingers.

BEGestureTypeTwoFingerSingleTap.doc: A gesture for a single simultaneous tap with two fingers.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a gesture option of the specified underlying value.

BESelectionFlags.doc: Flags that indicate different states or characteristics of a text selection.

BEPhraseBoundaryChanged.doc: A flag that indicates whether a text selection crosses or modifies phrase boundaries in an active selection.

BESelectionFlagsNone.doc: An option that indicates no active flags.

BESelectionFlipped.doc: A flag that indicates whether a text selection is reversed or flipped in direction from its original direction.

BEWordIsNearTap.doc: A flag that indicates whether a word resides near the person’s tap gesture.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a selection flags instance with the given underlying value.

BESelectionTouchPhase.doc: The different phases of touch interaction during text selection operations.

BESelectionTouchPhaseEnded.doc: A phase that indicates when the touch interaction for text selection completes without specifying movement direction.

BESelectionTouchPhaseEndedMovingBackward.doc: A phase that indicates when the touch interaction ends after moving in a backward direction.

BESelectionTouchPhaseEndedMovingForward.doc: A phase that indicates when the touch interaction ends after moving in a forward direction.

BESelectionTouchPhaseEndedNotMoving.doc: A phase that indicates when the touch interaction ends without any movement of the selection boundaries.

BESelectionTouchPhaseMoved.doc: A phase that indicates that a touch actively adjusts the text selection boundaries.

BESelectionTouchPhaseStarted.doc: A phase that indicates when a new touch interaction for text selection begins.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates a text selection phase with the specified underlying value.

bookmarkData.doc: A bookmark that resolves to the resource’s URL.

alternativeStrings.doc: An array of strings that represent alternatives to the currently selected text.

primaryString.doc: The original text that the alternatives derive from.

inputText.doc: Text that will be inserted into the document when the user chooses the suggestion.

shouldEvaluateURLs.doc: Determines whether the built-in web content filter is active.
